intro: Fifty-seven years of Miami-Dade plumbing does not photograph well — most of our best work is buried two feet under somebody's yard or sealed back inside a wall. A typical week looks like this: locate a main drain line under a Coconut Grove slab, dig down, repair it and cut in a clean-out so the next call takes minutes; pump and rebuild a failing septic tank south of the Trail; run the annual backflow test on a Coral Gables commercial property; replace a cast-iron sewer run in a 1950s house; and answer whatever comes in at 2am. We are collecting job photography now — in the meantime, the reviews on this site are from real customers describing real jobs, and we are happy to give references for work like yours.
